settings.featureOptIn.campaigns.title: Opt-In to Campaigns
settings.featureOptIn.campaigns.descript: Campaigns allow you to create and participate in loyalty and reward programmes.
settings.featureOptIn.marketplace.title: Opt-In to Marketplace
settings.featureOptIn.marketplace.descri: The Marketplace feature allows you to place orders from popular third-party online stores on behalf of your customers, earning a service fee for each order.
settings.featureOptIn.boph.title: Opt-In to BOPH
settings.featureOptIn.boph.description: BOPH (Buy Online, Pickup Here) lets your store act as a pickup point for online orders. You'll manage incoming parcels and hand them off to customers, earning a fee for the service.
settings.featureOptIn.buyStock.title: Opt-In to Buy Stock
settings.featureOptIn.buyStock.descripti: Buy Stock lets you order inventory and manage purchase orders for your store.
settings.checkout.title: Checkout display
settings.checkout.intro: When ON, VAT is added to the total (Total = Subtotal + VAT). When OFF, VAT is included in the total (no addition).
settings.checkout.showVat.label: Show VAT in checkout summary
settings.checkout.showVat.description: When ON, VAT is added on top (Total = Subtotal + VAT). When OFF, VAT is included in prices and the VAT line is hidden.

settings.staff.duplicatePhone.title: Number already registered
settings.staff.duplicatePhone.descriptio: This phone number is already registered for a staff member. Please use a different number.
settings.staff.transfer.title: Confirm Store Admin transfer
settings.staff.transfer.lead: You are transferring Store Admin to {{name}}. Please confirm below. This action cannot be undone.
settings.staff.transfer.details: After you confirm, this app signs you out and the new store admin should be signed out as well (existing sessions may stay valid until the server ends them or they expire). When both of you sign in again, roles will match the server—the previous store admin is deleted only if you select that option in the checkbox.
settings.staff.transfer.accountQuestion: What should happen to the current Store Admin account (you)?
settings.staff.transfer.uncheckedHint: keep the account and make them a staff user at this store.
settings.staff.transfer.checkedHint: remove or deactivate the current Store Admin per server rules.
